audit.definition: Source-qualified scalars and documented one-sided limits. Site ranges, patch maxima, uncertain positions, alternative correlations and count-only deposits remain in the evidence ledger.

support.definition: Exact-site Delaunay triangles: longest edge / minimum vertex third-neighbor distance and circumdiameter / median vertex third-neighbor distance both <= spacing factor.
support.interpretation: Geometry-screened interpolation footprint, not a confidence region, deposit boundary, or guarantee of representativeness. Bounds alone do not establish two-sided local support.

buffer_rule.rule: Median nearest-distinct-site distance; halve to 1/2, 1/4, then zero only if an inner training set lacks six exact values/four distinct non-collinear sites.
buffer_rule.uses: Coordinates and observation kinds only; never thickness values.

contours.display_rule: Exact sites bracket the level at distinct vertices and at least 90% of draws cross it in this triangle. Display only.

peaks.rule: Original mapped maximum, vent, all accepted sites and triangle vertices, plus 49 radii and 128 bearings inside the nearest accepted radius. Finite search on 512 posterior fields.

unobserved_proximal_cap.assumption: Add the positive part of background-minus-local source thickness with a cubed parabolic taper to the nearest accepted site. One universal unobserved proximal scenario.
